Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of Q1 FY 27 earnings conference call held on August 01, 2026 
 
Ref: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), 
Regulations, 2015 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 and further to our intimation letter dated July 24, 2026, we hereby inform 
that the audio recording of the earnings call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026                        
held on August 01, 2026 at 14:00 Hrs. (IST) have been uploaded on our website under Investors 
relations section at the following weblink: 
 
https://www.divislabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Earnings_Call_Audio_Q1FY27.webm 
 
This is for your information and records.   
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Divi's Laboratories Limited 
 
 
 
M. Satish Choudhury
